_comment: Online (telerehab_questionnaire_app_v2.html) vs paper OMR (omr_scanner.html) item crosswalk. 'same' = identical published item or near-verbatim wording: may be pooled at item level with mode as a covariate. 'construct' = same construct, different wording: compare at construct-score level only. 'none' = no counterpart. Mappings are the analyst's judgement and need PI/psychometric review before analysis (v1.0, pending validation).
